name: Currency Manager for Gravity Forms
author: IdeaWP

sections.description:
Currency Manager for Gravity Forms is nifty utility for Gravity Forms users who need more flexibility with currencies in Gravity Forms.

By default, Gravity Forms supports a limited number of currencies; often the ones you need are not included. This plugin allows you to add new currencies or update existing currencies used within the Gravity Forms plugin.
sections.installation:
• Download the plugin zip file.
  • Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard.
  • Navigate to Plugins > Add New.
  • Click on the Upload Plugin button.
  • Choose the downloaded zip file and click Install Now.
  • Once installed, click Activate Plugin.
sections.faq:
Will this override existing currency settings?

No. It only adds and modifies the currency options available — your existing settings remain intact unless changed manually.

Will the currencies remain after I deactivate this plugin?

No, newly added currencies or edits will only be available when the plugin is active.

How can I add support for Multi-currency

To add support for multi-currency switcher, you can use our other plugin, Multi-currency for Gravity Forms.
